calendar_week.description: ISO planning weeks of the plan year. Week index 0 starts on the planning as-of date.

fields.name: week_index
fields.description: 0-based week offset from the as-of date

location.lifecycle: ACTIVE (all synthetic locations are active in the horizon)

supplier.description: External suppliers. Capacity is in supplier_capacity; lanes and lead times in lead_time.
supplier.lifecycle: ACTIVE -> ON_HOLD (policy: no new POs while ON_HOLD)

fields.name: is_overseas
fields.description: Ships by sea from outside the network

fields.name: status
fields.description: ON_HOLD suppliers may not receive new purchase orders

sku.description: Stock-keeping units: purchased finished goods, manufactured finished goods and purchased components.
sku.lifecycle: NEW -> ACTIVE -> PHASE_OUT; no demand outside [effective_from, effective_to]

fields.name: sourcing_type
fields.description: BUY from suppliers or MAKE in a plant

fields.name: unit_price
fields.description: Selling price per base unit (finished goods only)

fields.name: abc_class
fields.description: Derived Pareto class on annual demand value (A=80%, B=15%, C=5%)

fields.name: effective_from
fields.description: First date the SKU can be sold/planned

sku_location.description: Bridge resolving the N:M SKU<->Location relationship; holds stocking policy.
sku_location.grain: one row per stocked SKU at a location

fields.name: safety_stock_qty
fields.description: Derived: ceil(z(ABC) * 0.3 * mean weekly demand * sqrt(lead-time weeks))

supplier_sku.description: Bridge resolving N:M Supplier<->SKU; purchasing terms (UoM, MOQ, multiple, price).
supplier_sku.grain: one row per supplier offering a SKU

fields.name: order_multiple
fields.description: Order quantity must be a multiple of this

lead_time.description: Effective-dated lead time per supplier->location lane. Revisions add a new version; history is kept.
lead_time.grain: one row per lane per version

fields.name: version
fields.description: Version number within the lane (1 = original)

fields.name: expedite_premium_pct
fields.description: Expedite surcharge as % of line value

fields.name: effective_to
fields.rule: versions of a lane do not overlap; v(n).effective_to = v(n+1).effective_from - 1 day

supplier_capacity.description: Weekly shipping capacity per supplier across all SKUs, in base units, measured on PO ship week.
supplier_capacity.grain: one row per supplier per planning week

fields.name: capacity_units
fields.description: Maximum base units the supplier can ship in the week

forecast_demand.description: Independent weekly forecast demand per SKU-location (finished goods only).
forecast_demand.grain: one row per SKU, location and week within the SKU's effective window

inventory.description: Inventory snapshot at the as-of date: on-hand, quality hold and in-transit (linked to the PO line).
inventory.grain: one row per SKU-location-stock status (in-transit: per PO line)

fields.name: po_line_id
fields.rule: required iff stock_status = IN_TRANSIT; at most one IN_TRANSIT row per PO line

purchase_order.description: Inbound purchase order header (one supplier -> one receiving location). Status is derived from events.
purchase_order.lifecycle: PLANNED -> CONFIRMED -> IN_TRANSIT -> RECEIVED; PLANNED|CONFIRMED -> CANCELLED

fields.name: order_date
fields.description: Date the order is (or will be) released to the supplier

fields.name: transport_delay_days
fields.description: Derived: sum of DELAY_REPORTED event delays

fields.name: actual_receipt_date
fields.rule: required iff status = RECEIVED; < as-of date

fields.name: status
fields.description: Derived: to_status of the latest event

purchase_order_line.description: PO line: one SKU, ordered in the supplier's purchase UoM.

fields.name: order_qty
fields.rule: <= requested_qty; >= MOQ and multiple of order_multiple
fields.description: Quantity confirmed by the supplier (capacity-limited suppliers may cut it)

purchase_order_event.description: Append-only state-change history of purchase orders. History is never overwritten.

fields.name: event_timestamp
fields.rule: strictly increasing per PO; < as-of date

bom.description: Bill of materials: N:M bridge between manufactured SKUs and component SKUs.

fields.name: qty_per
fields.description: Component base units per parent unit

production_capacity.description: Weekly production capacity per plant (all manufactured SKUs), in base units.
production_capacity.grain: one row per plant per week

production_plan.description: Planned production of manufactured SKUs per plant and week.
production_plan.grain: one row per SKU, plant and week with production

fields.name: planned_qty
fields.rule: <= required_qty; multiple of batch_size; plant total <= production_capacity

fields.name: status
fields.description: FIRM inside the 2-week frozen fence, else PLANNED

sku_substitute.description: N:M self-bridge on SKU: which SKU may replace another. Only APPROVED and effective links are usable.

scheduled_receipt.description: Every open PO line as used by the plan, with any correction applied (source rows are never modified).
scheduled_receipt.grain: one row per open PO line

fields.name: source_base_qty
fields.description: base_qty as recorded on the line

fields.name: planning_base_qty
fields.description: Quantity used in the plan after UoM correction

fields.name: planning_receipt_date
fields.description: Receipt date used after lead-time / capacity corrections

fields.name: ship_week_index
fields.description: Week index the supplier ships (capacity bucket)

fields.name: counted_in_plan
fields.description: False if cancelled, outside horizon or unconvertible

projected_balance.description: Week-by-week projected available balance (PAB). closing = opening + receipts + production - demand - dependent demand.

shortage.description: Shortage episode: consecutive weeks with negative projected balance for a SKU-location.

fields.name: lead_time_weeks
fields.description: First week index a normal action can land: week of (as-of + primary lane total_lead_days) for purchased items; frozen fence (2) for manufactured items

fields.name: within_lead_time
fields.description: start_week_index < lead_time_weeks: cannot be fixed by a normal order

shortage_cause.description: Explainable causes of each shortage with quantified contribution and evidence record IDs.
shortage_cause.grain: one row per cause per shortage

mitigation_option.description: Feasible mitigation alternatives per shortage with cost / service trade-offs. All pass policy and capacity checks.

fields.name: incremental_cost
fields.description: Premium over normal replenishment (or lost margin for backorder)

rejected_mitigation.description: Candidates that were considered and rejected, with the policy or constraint that failed.

detected_issue.description: Exceptions detected by the planning engine's data-quality screen, with the decision taken.

supplier_capacity_utilization.description: Committed open-PO load and mitigation reservations versus supplier capacity per week.

fields.name: source_committed_units
fields.description: Load as recorded in source POs

production_capacity_utilization.description: Planned production plus mitigation reservations versus plant capacity per week.

ground_truth.description: Labels for injected edge cases and generator scenario drivers. Stored outside the input folder.

fields.name: expected_decision
fields.description: What a correct planner/engine must do
